say:5:1064001003:1.text: You guys are here... Wait, where's Senshi?
say:5:1064001003:1.source_cn: 玛露西尔、齐尔查克、森……呃？森西呢？

say:6:1064001004:1.text: Senshi has teleportation sickness, so he's resting over there.
say:6:1064001004:1.source_cn: 森西晕传送，正在一旁休息。

say:7:1064001005:1.text: I think we got here from the dungeon through teleportation.
say:7:1064001005:1.source_cn: 我们似乎在迷宫里被传送出来了。

say:10:1064001007:1.text: Hi, my name is Hammie, and you're in the land of Esperia.
say:10:1064001007:1.source_cn: 你好，我是漫漫。这里是伊索米亚。

say:11:1064001008:1.source_cn: 等等——会说话的仓鼠魔物？

say:14:1064001010:1.text: Chippy and Hammie are familiars that can only be created by strong mages. We call them Magisters.
say:14:1064001010:1.source_cn: 满满和漫漫是强大的魔法师——也就是我们那里被称为魔术师...

say:16:1064001011:1.text: Marcille's right! We're the familiars of Magister Merlin, the most powerful mage in Esperia!
say:16:1064001011:1.source_cn: 玛露西尔小姐说得没错！我们的主人正是伊索米亚最强大的魔...

say:18:1064001012:1.text: That name doesn't ring a bell...

say:23:1064001014:1.text: Are you alright, Sir? You don't seem well. Please, allow us to take you to the Mystical House for treatment.
say:23:1064001014:1.source_cn: 这位森西先生看起来状态不是很好，先跟我们回神秘屋治疗一下吧。

say:25:1064001015:1.text: You can help Senshi? Thank you!
say:25:1064001015:1.source_cn: 有办法治疗吗？那就拜托你们了。

say:28:1064001016:0.text: Hey, don't go just yet! I'm still confused!
say:28:1064001016:0.source_cn: 等等，还是没有人跟我解释清楚状况啊！别走啊——

narration:30:1064001017:1.text: Hammie and Chippy bring Marcille and her companions back to the Mystical House...
narration:30:1064001017:1.source_cn: 漫漫和满满带着玛露西尔一行人返回了神秘屋……

say:33:1064001019:1.text: This gentleman just teleported here, and he's feeling sick!
say:33:1064001019:1.source_cn: 这位森西先生晕传送晕得很厉害！

say:35:1064001020:1.text: Senshi's a dwarf, so he easily gets teleportation sickness...
say:35:1064001020:1.source_cn: 森西是矮人，是很容易晕传送的体质……

say:36:1064001021:1.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. Nice to meet you, Magister Merlin! I'm Marcille, also a mage.
say:36:1064001021:1.source_cn: 啊，忘记自我介绍了。梅林<male>先生</male>...

choice_prompt:37:1064001021.text: Oh, I forgot to introduce myself. Nice to meet you, Magister Merlin! I'm Marcille, also a mage.
choice_prompt:37:1064001021.source_cn: 啊，忘记自我介绍了。梅林<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，我是玛露西尔，也是一名魔法师。

narration:43:1064001024:1.text: Under your treatment, Senshi is starting to feel better.

narration:44:1064001025:0.text: Chippy and Hammie eagerly recount your past feats to the four, their tone laced with enthusiasm and a hint of bragging.
narration:44:1064001025:0.source_cn: 莱欧斯、玛露西尔、齐尔查克和森西也在满满和漫漫的热情说...

narration:45:1064001026:0.text: Meanwhile, you learn that they are adventurers from another dimension. They explored the dungeon in search of Falin, their companion who was eaten by the Red Dragon.
narration:45:1064001026:0.source_cn: 你也得知了他们是来自于另一个世界的冒险者。他们在迷宫中...

narration:46:1064001027:1.text: After reviving Falin, they encountered the Lord of the Dungeon and were forced to part ways with her once more.

narration:47:1064001028:1.text: They then lost their way in the ever-changing dungeon and encountered a monster they had neither seen nor heard of.

narration:48:1064001029:1.text: They passed out while battling the monster. When they woke up, they found themselves in Esperia.

say:50:1064001030:1.text: Your journey is full of ups and downs! Chippy feels for you...
say:50:1064001030:1.source_cn: 好曲折的冒险！满满听着都觉得辛苦……

say:51:1064001031:0.text: It's definitely been a tough ride, but along the way, we got to taste monsters with different flavors.
say:51:1064001031:0.source_cn: 是有点辛苦了，但也品尝到了很多不同风味的魔物。

say:52:1064001032:1.text: You mean you ate them?! Good heavens! You won't eat Chippy, will you?
say:52:1064001032:1.source_cn: ……吃魔物？！呜哇，你们不会、不会吃满满吧？！

say:57:1064001034:0.text: Laios, don't scare them! And seriously, can you quiet your stomach down for a bit?
say:57:1064001034:0.source_cn: 莱欧斯！不要吓人啦！还有，你的肚子叫得太大声了——

say:58:1064001035:1.text: Fret not, Chippy! We don't eat every monster we come across—we pick and choose which kinds to eat.
say:58:1064001035:1.source_cn: 别担心，满满！我们可不是什么魔物都吃的，我们会挑选对象的。

say:62:1064001037:0.text: *Cough* I can't let youngsters go hungry...
say:62:1064001037:0.source_cn: 咳咳，不能……让年轻人饿肚子……

say:65:1064001038:1.text: Sorry to keep you waiting! Magister Merlin asked me to prepare a meal for you. Please eat this and take a good rest.
say:65:1064001038:1.source_cn: 久等了！根据梅林大人的吩咐我准备了食物，请好好享用并休息吧。

say:66:1064001039:1.text: Behold, the Noble Tavern's signature set! It comes with fried chicken wings with radish sauce, paired with the refreshing glowfly fruit brew.
say:66:1064001039:1.source_cn: 请品尝我们月桂酒馆的招牌套餐吧！秘制炸鸡翅配特色葱萝酱...

say:68:1064001040:0.text: Chicken wings?! Finally, some normal food! *Sob*
say:68:1064001040:0.source_cn: 鸡翅？！好正常的食材，呜呜——

say:70:1064001041:1.text: Finally, I get to eat a meal that doesn't involve monsters!
say:70:1064001041:1.source_cn: 太好了！终于能吃到魔物以外的食物了！

say:72:1064001042:1.source_cn: 唔，这个啤酒闻起来好香——

say:75:1064001044:1.text: Ahh! The foam is fine, and the body is rich and smooth! The fruity and malty flavors are perfectly balanced!
say:75:1064001044:1.source_cn: 嗝——上层泡沫细腻，酒体醇厚顺滑！果味和麦芽醇香完美平衡！

say:77:1064001045:1.text: Mmm, this is divine! I'm feeling better already.
say:77:1064001045:1.source_cn: 呼！老夫也觉得不错，似乎觉得连眩晕感都好了不少。

say:79:1064001046:1.text: Yummy! Crispy skin and succulent, juicy meat... Quite similar to the texture of Basilisk, if you ask me.
say:79:1064001046:1.source_cn: 美味！外皮酥脆，内里多汁……和蛇尾鸡的口感有一些相似呢。

say:81:1064001047:1.text: It's the other way around! This is the real chicken!
say:81:1064001047:1.source_cn: 本末倒置了！这才是纯正的鸡肉啊！

say:83:1064001048:1.text: ...Speaking of Basilisk, how do we get back to the dungeon?
say:83:1064001048:1.source_cn: ……说到蛇尾鸡，我们要怎么回迷宫啊？

say:84:1064001049:0.text: I'm just as lost as you.

say:85:1064001050:0.text: We haven't even figured out how we got here...
say:85:1064001050:0.source_cn: 我们怎么过来的都没有搞清楚……

say:86:1064001051:0.text: We were fighting a monster before we passed out, right?
say:86:1064001051:0.source_cn: 我们晕过去之前是跟一个魔物战斗吧？

choice_prompt:87:1064001051.text: We were fighting a monster before we passed out, right?
choice_prompt:87:1064001051.source_cn: 我们晕过去之前是跟一个魔物战斗吧？

say:88:1064001052:1.text: None of us has seen or heard of the monster before.
say:88:1064001052:1.source_cn: 我们没有一个人见过或者听说过。

choice_prompt:89:1064001052.text: None of us has seen or heard of the monster before.
choice_prompt:89:1064001052.source_cn: 我们没有一个人见过或者听说过。

say:90:1064001053:1.text: Hmm... It looked like an octopus, with eight tentacles protecting its sac-like core.
say:90:1064001053:1.source_cn: 唔……那个魔物有着类似章鱼的构造，有八个腕足保护着囊状核心。

say:91:1064001054:1.text: It had several eyes on its head; its deep purple body is covered in star-like spots.
say:91:1064001054:1.source_cn: 头上有着好几只深紫色的眼睛，并且带着星光状的斑点。

say:92:1064001055:1.text: You noticed all that in such a short time...
say:92:1064001055:1.source_cn: 亏你能在短时间内观察这么细……

say:95:1064001056:1.text: Magister... I think I might have seen it in one of your magic tomes.
say:95:1064001056:1.source_cn: 梅林……我好像在你珍藏的魔法书里有见到过这样的魔物。

say:97:1064001057:1.text: Oh, is that so? Magister Merlin, may I have a look at that tome?

choice_prompt:98:1064001057.text: Oh, is that so? Magister Merlin, may I have a look at that tome?
choice_prompt:98:1064001057.source_cn: 咦？真的吗？梅林<male>先生</male><female>女士</female>，请问那本书在哪里？

say:99:1064001058:1.text: No... We need to find a way back, or Falin...
say:99:1064001058:1.source_cn: 那怎么办？我们得想办法回去，毕竟法琳现在……

say:100:1064001059:1.text: Don't worry, Marcille. The magic tome should be around here somewhere. The Magister and I will look for it!
say:100:1064001059:1.source_cn: 玛露西尔，先别着急。那本书应该就在神秘屋里，我和主人去...

say:101:1064001060:1.text: I'll help too! I study ancient magic! Maybe I could help!
say:101:1064001060:1.source_cn: 我也来帮忙！我研究的是古代魔法，或许能派上用场！

choice:37:0:1.text: Nice to meet you! Let me see what I can do.
choice:37:0:1.source_cn: 认识你很高兴，我先看看森西先生的情况
choice:37:0:1.male: Nice to meet you! Let me see what I can do.
choice:37:0:1.female: Nice to meet you! Let me see what I can do.

say:1:1064002001:1.text: Marcille, your face is pale. You didn't find the tome?
say:1:1064002001:1.source_cn: 玛露西尔，你的脸色好差，是没找到那本书吗？

say:3:1064002002:1.text: ...We found it, but... Well, I don't know what to say.

say:8:1064002004:1.text: Hammie emerges behind Marcille, holding a magic tome with an exquisite cover. There is a striking gold embossed title on the cover...
say:8:1064002004:1.source_cn: 漫漫从玛露西尔身后现身，举起了一本封面精致的魔法书。书...

say:13:1064002007:1.text: We searched high and low through the Magister's collection, and only this book features the monster Laios described.
say:13:1064002007:1.source_cn: 我们翻遍了主人的藏书，确实只在这本书里见到了莱欧斯描述...

say:17:1064002008:1.text: A book that talks about both culinary skills and summoning spells? I've never seen anything like it before...
say:17:1064002008:1.source_cn: 我还是第一次看到把料理和召唤魔法混在一起的书……

say:18:1064002009:1.text: Isn't that idea a bit too far-fetched?
say:18:1064002009:1.source_cn: 有点太过超越常规了吧？

say:20:1064002010:1.text: It's not all that unusual for me. Cookbooks aren't all about cooking instructions, you know.
say:20:1064002010:1.source_cn: 老夫倒是不觉得奇怪。食谱从来不只是简单的烹饪指南——

say:21:1064002011:0.text: What it embodies is a curiosity to understand the world through diverse foods.
say:21:1064002011:0.source_cn: 它记录的不仅是如何烹饪食物，更是对世界的探索。

say:22:1064002012:1.text: Why don't we check what's inside before jumping to any conclusions?
say:22:1064002012:1.source_cn: 我们不妨先打开看看内容，再做判断。

document:23:239:1.text:
Summoner's Stew Recipe

<style="highlight">Warning!</style>
Summoning a chaotic monster is risky business! When this dish is done, it will twist space and time!
This recipe is verified by ancient mages and chefs and recorded in ▇▇▇▇

<style="highlight">Ingredient 1: Ancient Bones</style>
You'll need bones from a creature that's lived a thousand years or more. The best ones come from desert monsters, as their bones have been soaking up the earth's essence for centuries. You must cut them under moonlight using silver tools.
A note on sourcing: We do not recommend using your great-great-grandfather's remains, no matter how "ancient" they seem.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 2: Deepsea Liver</style>
Picking the right organ is the tricky part. You want one from those ancient races that live in the deepest, darkest parts of the ocean.
After collecting it, keep it submerged in water from its native environment. Do not let it get exposed to the air.

<style="highlight">Ingredient 3: Psychic Monster Meat</style>
The psychic monster meat is both the trickiest yet the most essential ingredient, as these creatures can manipulate minds or create illusions.
It is recommended to wear a tinfoil hat during this step.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 4: Rich Element Essence</style>
Element essence serves as a medium to combine other ingredients. Any essence will do, as long as it is pure.

<style="highlight">Cooking Steps</style>
Prepare a large cauldron. Add the ingredients in sequence while stirring continuously.
First stir three times clockwise, then twice counterclockwise. Repeat this process until the contents of the cauldron shimmer with a prismatic shade of black.
If it turns polka-dotted, you've stirred too vigorously.
document:23:239:1.source_cn:
混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅制作方法
<style="highlight">【警告】</style>
召唤混沌类魔物需谨慎，此料理一旦烹制完成，将在现实中创造出时空扭曲！
以下配方由古代魔法师&厨师亲自验证，记录于▇▇▇▇

<style="highlight">【材料一·远古生物骨骼】</style>
远古生物骨骼必须来自存活超过千年的生物，沙漠巨兽最为理想，其骨骼经历漫长岁月吸收了大地精华。
切割需在有月光的夜晚，使用银制工具，切忌使用铁器碰触。
 
<style="highlight">【材料二·海底生物的肝脏】</style>
海底生物的肝脏选取尤为关键。应选择生活在海底的古老种族，越是不见天日者越佳。
采集后的肝脏必须保存在原生环境的水中，切不可接触空气。

<style="highlight">【材料三·拥有精神属性的怪物肉】</style>
拥有精神属性的怪物肉最为危险，也最为关键。此类生物往往具有操控心智或制造幻象的能力。
处理肉块时需要格外小心精神污染。
 
<style="highlight">【材料四·浓郁的元素精华】</style>
浓郁的元素精华是联结其他材料的媒介，使用何种元素皆可，但必须为纯净元素。

<style="highlight">【烹制步骤】</style>
准备一个大坩埚，将材料依序放入后持续搅拌——
先顺时针三圈，再逆时针两圈，如此反复直至锅内呈现出五彩斑斓的黑色。

say:23:1064002013:2.text: Well, from a culinary standpoint, the content of this cookbook is quite sound.
say:23:1064002013:2.source_cn: 嗯……这个食谱，从烹饪的角度看，其实是相当合理的。

choice_prompt:24:1064002013.text: Well, from a culinary standpoint, the content of this cookbook is quite sound.
choice_prompt:24:1064002013.source_cn: 嗯……这个食谱，从烹饪的角度看，其实是相当合理的。

say:25:1064002014:0.text: ... Indeed. The underlying principles are similar to summoning spells.
say:25:1064002014:0.source_cn: ……确实如此，原理和召唤术有些类似。

say:27:1064002015:1.text: Great! Time to hit the road and gather the ingredients for the recipe!
say:27:1064002015:1.source_cn: 那就这么决定了！我们立刻上路，收集食材吧！

say:29:1064002016:1.text: Wait, shouldn't we give it a bit more thought?
say:29:1064002016:1.source_cn: 等等，你决定得也太快了吧！

say:30:1064002017:1.text: What's the wait? It's not like we have other options.
say:30:1064002017:1.source_cn: 反正也没有别的办法了，不如就这么试试看。

say:31:1064002018:1.text: Besides, I'm curious about how the dish tastes.
say:31:1064002018:1.source_cn: 再说，我也很好奇最终的味道呢。

say:34:1064002020:1.text: The problem is, where can we find the ingredients?
say:34:1064002020:1.source_cn: 但问题是，食材去哪里找？

choice_prompt:35:1064002020.text: The problem is, where can we find the ingredients?
choice_prompt:35:1064002020.source_cn: 但问题是，食材去哪里找？

say:37:1064002021:1.text: We're familiar with those ingredients. Just count on us!
say:37:1064002021:1.source_cn: 我们之前的旅程中见过类似的东西，一定能帮到你们！

say:39:1064002022:1.text: Let's move! Our first destination is—uh... where are we going?
say:39:1064002022:1.source_cn: 那就出发吧！第一站是——呃……是哪里？

narration:43:1064002024:1.text: Soon, you arrive in the Ashen Wastes, a vast sandy expanse with enormous bones jutting out from the ground here and there.

say:45:1064002025:0.text: *Huff*... My armor is almost hot enough to be a grill.
say:45:1064002025:0.source_cn: 呼……铠甲有点烫了，在上面放烤肉应该能三成熟吧。

say:47:1064002026:0.text: The soil here is unique. While it's just regular gravel at the top, beneath the layer is actually—
say:47:1064002026:0.source_cn: 这里的土质有些特别，表层是普通的风化沙砾，但下层——

say:49:1064002027:0.text: Hold on! I hear something coming from over there...

say:52:1064002028:1.text: Something round is rolling over from afar at high speed, stirring up clouds of dust. Behind it comes another voice.
say:52:1064002028:1.source_cn: 远处，一个球状物伴随着烟尘高速朝你们滚来。后方还传来了...

say:59:1064002032:1.text: Oh no, we won't make it in time!

say:61:1064002033:1.text: We have no choice but to fight here!
say:61:1064002033:1.source_cn: 现在已经跑不掉了！只能战斗了！

say:63:1064002034:1.text: Woah! Did you just curl yourself into a ball?!
say:63:1064002034:1.source_cn: 你居然能将身体团成一个球？！

say:65:1064002035:1.text: Hey, shouldn't you be focusing on the sandworm right now?!
say:65:1064002035:1.source_cn: ——我说，现在更重要的是想想如何对付沙虫吧？！

say:66:1064002036:1.source_cn: 尤其是沙虫已经追上来了啊啊啊！

choice:35:0:1.text: I know where to find them.
choice:35:0:1.male: I know where to find them.
choice:35:0:1.female: I know where to find them.

choice:24:0:1.text: It makes sense from a magical perspective.
choice:24:0:1.source_cn: 从魔法的角度看也有些道理
choice:24:0:1.male: It makes sense from a magical perspective.
choice:24:0:1.female: It makes sense from a magical perspective.

say:1:1064003001:0.text: Phew, we finally finished it off... Can't believe my explosive spell barely caused a dent in the sandworm's carapace...
say:1:1064003001:0.source_cn: 总算解决了……沙虫铠甲好硬，爆炸魔法竟然都伤不到它……

say:3:1064003002:1.text: You should never underestimate Setsahara, the king of Ashen Wastes.
say:3:1064003002:1.source_cn: 毕竟是我们荒角沙漠的沙王——萨纳斯潘特。

say:4:1064003003:1.text: In the monster category, it's definitely the legendary kind.
say:4:1064003003:1.source_cn: 也算是传说级别的怪物了！

say:6:1064003004:1.text: What a cool name! Let me jot it down for future occasions.
say:6:1064003004:1.source_cn: 好厉害的名字，可以记下来当命名参考。

say:8:1064003005:1.text: ...What kind of creature would need a name like that?
say:8:1064003005:1.source_cn: ……什么东西才会用到这种名字啊。

say:11:1064003007:1.text: My name is Alsa, and he's Soren. Both of us are members of the Uru Clan.
say:11:1064003007:1.source_cn: 我是阿尔萨，他是索恩！我们来自乌尔氏族！

say:12:1064003008:1.text: Magister Merlin, it's been so long! Are they your new companions?
say:12:1064003008:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，好久不见！他们是你的新同伴吗？

choice_prompt:13:1064003008.text: Magister Merlin, it's been so long! Are they your new companions?
choice_prompt:13:1064003008.source_cn: 梅林大人，好久不见！他们是你的新同伴吗？

say:14:1064003009:1.text: A dungeon full of monsters? Wow, your world sounds awesome!
say:14:1064003009:1.source_cn: 哇！另一个世界也太酷了！有迷宫和各种魔物啊……

say:15:1064003010:1.text: What brings you to the Ashen Wastes?
say:15:1064003010:1.source_cn: 你们怎么会来荒角沙漠？

say:17:1064003011:1.text: We're looking for ancient bones, which could help us get home.
say:17:1064003011:1.source_cn: 我们来找远古生物骨骼，有了它说不定我们就能回去了。

say:18:1064003012:1.text: You've come to the right place! We know just where the oldest bones lie, don't we, Soren?
say:18:1064003012:1.source_cn: 那你们真是来对地方啦！我们知道哪里有最古老的骨骼，对吧...

say:20:1064003014:1.text: Now, why don't we split up? I'll bring you to the bones, while Soren—
say:20:1064003014:1.source_cn: 既然如此，我们分头行动。我带你们去找骨骼！索恩——

choice_prompt:21:1064003014.text: Now, why don't we split up? I'll bring you to the bones, while Soren—
choice_prompt:21:1064003014.source_cn: 既然如此，我们分头行动。我带你们去找骨骼！索恩——

say:22:1064003015:1.text: Let's head back to our clan first then! We can feast on this huge sandworm.
say:22:1064003015:1.source_cn: 那就先跟我们回部落里休整吧，正好尝尝这个大沙虫！

say:23:1064003016:1.text: But having said that, since it's our first time trying it too, I can't guarantee how it'll taste...
say:23:1064003016:1.source_cn: 呃，不保证味道！因为我们也是第一次吃……

say:24:1064003017:0.text: Is this your first time eating it too? I thought it was a common ingredient here...
say:24:1064003017:0.source_cn: 你们没有吃过吗？我还以为这是这里常见的食物。

say:25:1064003018:1.text: Well, sandworms are a tough nut to crack. We normally just steer clear of them.
say:25:1064003018:1.source_cn: 不是啦，沙虫很难打的。一般我们都是躲着走。

say:26:1064003019:1.text: It seems to be their mating season lately...
say:26:1064003019:1.source_cn: 但最近似乎是沙虫的求偶期……

say:27:1064003020:0.text: So they have been moving beyond their usual territory and growing more aggressive!
say:27:1064003020:0.source_cn: 它的活动范围和脾气都变大了！

say:28:1064003021:0.text: We wouldn't have survived earlier without you guys!
say:28:1064003021:0.source_cn: 幸亏有你们在，不然我们肯定遭殃啦！

say:29:1064003022:0.text: It's getting hotter. We can talk as we go.
say:29:1064003022:0.source_cn: 日头越来越大了，边走边说。

narration:31:1064003023:1.text: Together, you carry the massive sandworm back to the oasis of the Uru Clan. Senshi and Laios spend a long time examining the sandworm.
narration:31:1064003023:1.source_cn: 你们合力将巨大的沙虫运回了乌尔氏族的绿洲。森西和莱欧斯...

say:33:1064003024:1.text: This creature is truly a wonder. Though it lives in the desert, its carapace resembles that of a sea crustacean.
say:33:1064003024:1.source_cn: 真是奇特的生物，生活在沙漠，但是外壳结构却像是甲壳类的...

say:35:1064003025:1.text: Hmm, with this body structure, maybe I can try sliding the knife in through the gaps in the shell...
say:35:1064003025:1.source_cn: 那么，根据结构得在甲壳接缝处下刀，老夫先试试看……

say:37:1064003026:1.text: After some precise cutting, Senshi carefully removes the sandworm's tough carapace.
say:37:1064003026:1.source_cn: 森西沿着接缝巧妙地切割后，慢慢剥开了沙虫坚硬的外壳。

say:39:1064003027:1.source_cn: 哇！里面竟然是白色的肉！

say:40:1064003028:1.text: And it looks so fresh and tender!

say:42:1064003029:1.text: The texture seems firm too, probably thanks to its frequent fast movement.
say:42:1064003029:1.source_cn: 肉质看起来也很紧实。唔，或许跟它经常高速移动有关。

say:43:1064003030:1.text: I'm wondering what it tastes like!
say:43:1064003030:1.source_cn: 就是不知道尝起来什么味道？

say:44:1064003031:1.text: I've heard it tastes like somewhere between beef and chicken...
say:44:1064003031:1.source_cn: 听说介于牛肉和鸡肉之间……

say:46:1064003032:1.text: I'll dice the meat and make it into skewers. That way, we can taste its original flavor.
say:46:1064003032:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就切块做成肉串。这样能品尝到它最原始的味道。

say:49:1064003034:1.text: I'll prepare some sandstone nut powder as seasoning.
say:49:1064003034:1.source_cn: 那我去准备点盐津仁粉，作为撒料。

say:50:1064003035:1.text: Hmm, what else... Ah, I can get some snakebone grass juice as a beverage!
say:50:1064003035:1.source_cn: 嗯……那我去弄点蛇骨草水来，给大家解腻。

say:52:1064003036:1.text: Is that a plant? I'd like to take a look!
say:52:1064003036:1.source_cn: 蛇骨草，是植物吗？我有点想看看！

say:54:1064003037:1.text: Chippy and I can pitch in!

say:56:1064003038:1.text: ...Why am I left all alone again?

choice_prompt:57:1064003038.text: ...Why am I left all alone again?

say:58:1064003039:1.text: Let me see if there's anything I can do...
say:58:1064003039:1.source_cn: 只能看看有没有什么力所能及的活了……

say:59:1064003040:1.text: Hmm, then I'll start getting the campfire ready.
say:59:1064003040:1.source_cn: 唔，那我们去准备篝火吧。

say:61:1064003041:1.text: And with that, everyone jumps into action with great enthusiasm.
say:61:1064003041:1.source_cn: 就这样，大家热火朝天地忙了起来。

say:62:1064003042:1.text: Soon, the <style="highlight">sandworm skewers</style> and <style="highlight">snakebone grass juice</style> are ready.

picture:62::2.source_cn: 盐津仁沙虫肉串与荒角蛇骨草水

say:64:1064003043:0.text: This is my first time preparing a sandworm dish. Go ahead and try it.
say:64:1064003043:0.source_cn: 老夫也是第一次料理沙虫肉，各位先尝尝看吧。

say:67:1064003045:1.text: It's crispy outside and tender inside! The juicy meat tastes sweeter than beef and more tender than chicken!
say:67:1064003045:1.source_cn: 外脆里嫩，肉质紧实又多汁！越嚼越多汁。比牛肉多了一丝甜...

say:70:1064003046:1.text: This is insane. How could an insect possibly taste like chicken or beef?
say:70:1064003046:1.source_cn: 怎么想都很奇怪？虫肉怎么会像鸡肉和牛肉……

choice_prompt:71:1064003046.text: This is insane. How could an insect possibly taste like chicken or beef?
choice_prompt:71:1064003046.source_cn: 怎么想都很奇怪？虫肉怎么会像鸡肉和牛肉……

say:72:1064003047:1.text: ... Guess I'll start with some snakebone grass juice first. If I'm still hungry later, I'll give it a go...
say:72:1064003047:1.source_cn: ……我还是先喝蛇骨草水吧。实在饿了……我再尝尝看！

say:74:1064003048:0.text: It's best to eat it while it's hot.

say:75:1064003049:0.source_cn: 呜，我知道啦。我现在就吃——

say:76:1064003050:1.text: Mmm, so delicious! It melts in my mouth but isn't greasy at all!
say:76:1064003050:1.source_cn: 好、好吃！入口即化，但又不腻！

say:78:1064003051:1.text: Eating meat by a bonfire... We haven't had such a good time in ages.
say:78:1064003051:1.source_cn: 在篝火旁吃肉串……好久没有那么悠闲了。

say:79:1064003052:1.text: I'd like some alcohol, but there are only children in this clan, after all.
say:79:1064003052:1.source_cn: 虽说这时候应该配上一杯酒，但这个部落里都是小孩子。

say:80:1064003053:1.text: Might not be appropriate from an educational standpoint...

say:82:1064003054:1.text: Do you always enjoy delicious food like this in the dungeon?
say:82:1064003054:1.source_cn: 你们在迷宫里也能吃到这么美味的食物吗？

say:84:1064003055:1.source_cn: 当然了，这都多亏了森西！

say:86:1064003056:1.text: Having a proper meal is always more important than anything else, no matter where we are.
say:86:1064003056:1.source_cn: 老夫只是觉得……无论身在哪里，吃好饭都是很重要的事情。

narration:87:1064003057:1.text: By the bonfire, you enjoy a delicious feast and share your past adventures until late into the night...

choice:71:0:1.text: You never know until you try.
choice:71:0:1.source_cn: 尝了才知道，不如先试试？
choice:71:0:1.male: You never know until you try.
choice:71:0:1.female: You never know until you try.

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 别急，骨骼得在夜晚获得

narration:0:1064004001:1.text: As moonlight illuminates the sands in the Ashen Wastes, you collect the bones of some ancient desert beasts with Soren leading the way.
narration:0:1064004001:1.source_cn: 月光洒满荒角沙漠时，你们在索恩的带领下，获得了远古沙漠...

narration:1:1064004002:1.text: With the first ingredient of the Summoner's Stew ready, you bid farewell to Soren and Alsa the following morning.

narration:2:1064004003:1.text: Through Valen's connections, you secure a ship and embark on a sea voyage.

document:4:418:0.text:
<style="highlight">Ingredient 1: Ancient Bones</style>
You'll need bones from a creature that's lived a thousand years or more. The best ones come from desert monsters, as their bones have been soaking up the earth's essence for centuries. You must cut them under moonlight using silver tools.
A note on sourcing: We do not recommend using your great-great-grandfather's remains, no matter how "ancient" they seem.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 2: Deepsea Liver</style>
Picking the right organ is the tricky part. You want one from those ancient races that live in the deepest, darkest parts of the ocean.
After collecting it, keep it submerged in water from its native environment. Do not let it get exposed to the air.
document:4:418:0.source_cn:
<style="highlight">【材料一·远古生物骨骼】</style>
远古生物骨骼必须来自存活超过千年的生物，沙漠巨兽最为理想，其骨骼经历漫长岁月吸收了大地精华。
切割需在有月光的夜晚，使用银制工具，切忌使用铁器碰触。
 
<style="highlight">【材料二·海底生物的肝脏】</style>
海底生物的肝脏选取尤为关键。应选择生活在海底的古老种族，越是不见天日者越佳。
采集后的肝脏必须保存在原生环境的水中，切不可接触空气。

say:5:1064004004:0.text: The liver of marine life... Isn't "marine life" a bit too vague?
say:5:1064004004:0.source_cn: 海底生物的肝脏……这个范围也太广了。

say:6:1064004005:1.text: What kind of creature should we use?
say:6:1064004005:1.source_cn: 到底该选择什么生物呢？

say:10:1064004007:1.text: The common species wouldn't cut it, I suppose.
say:10:1064004007:1.source_cn: 普通海洋生物的肝脏应该不够格吧？

say:11:1064004008:0.text: The recipe specifies an ancient species that dwells in the depths of the ocean...
say:11:1064004008:0.source_cn: 食谱上说要生活在海底的古老种族……

say:14:1064004010:0.text: Is it an intelligent species? No way! It's too cruel!
say:14:1064004010:0.source_cn: 该不会是有智慧的魔物吧？……不行，那样太残酷了！

say:15:1064004011:0.text: Hmm, what if it's a Mermaid?

say:17:1064004013:1.text: Marcille's right—we agreed not to harm any demi-humans!
say:17:1064004013:1.source_cn: 没错，我们说好不对亚人系生物下手的！

choice_prompt:18:1064004013.text: Marcille's right—we agreed not to harm any demi-humans!
choice_prompt:18:1064004013.source_cn: 没错，我们说好不对亚人系生物下手的！

say:20:1064004014:0.text: Ugh, just hearing the name makes me sick!

choice_prompt:21:1064004014.text: Ugh, just hearing the name makes me sick!

say:22:1064004015:0.text: Damedangler is just another name for a siren, right? That's why demi-humans are a no-go.
say:22:1064004015:0.source_cn: 冥湾美人就是赛莲的别名对吧？我说亚人系的不行啊——

say:24:1064004016:1.text: Relax, the damedangler is a deep-sea fish.
say:24:1064004016:1.source_cn: 不是啦，我们所说的冥湾美人其实是深海鱼。

say:25:1064004017:1.text: It looks nothing like a human! Actually, it's a bit scary.
say:25:1064004017:1.source_cn: 外表和人完全不相似，反倒是有点令人毛骨悚然。

say:27:1064004018:1.text: Scary, huh... Are you sure it's okay?
say:27:1064004018:1.source_cn: 毛骨悚然……真的没问题吗？

choice_prompt:28:1064004018.text: Scary, huh... Are you sure it's okay?
choice_prompt:28:1064004018.source_cn: 虽说是鱼，但这么恐怖真的没问题吗？

say:30:1064004019:1.text: How can we catch it then?
say:30:1064004019:1.source_cn: 既然生活在深海里，我们该如何捕获它呢？

say:32:1064004020:0.text: We've caught some before. Just leave it to us!
say:32:1064004020:0.source_cn: 主人和我们之前钓到过，交给我们吧。

say:34:1064004021:1.text: Drawing from your previous experiences, you prepare the special bait and cast your rod in the area where damedanglers are most commonly found.
say:34:1064004021:1.source_cn: 你们根据之前的经历，准备好了特制的饵蚯，并在它常出没的...

say:38:1064004023:1.text: Chilchuck, fishing is all about patience.

say:43:1064004026:0.source_cn: 好像有什么歌声传了过来。

say:45:1064004027:1.text: This is... a Mermaid! They're trying to lure us out.
say:45:1064004027:1.source_cn: 我明白了，是人鱼——她们试图引诱我们！

say:47:1064004028:0.text: Trust me, I can handle this! La la lu lu woo wah wah—
say:47:1064004028:0.source_cn: 交给我，我有办法！啦啦啊啊啊呜哇哇——

narration:49:1064004029:1.text: By the time Laios had finished singing to the end, the Mermaids have fled the area in fear.

narration:50:1064004030:1.text: But those on the ship have nowhere to escape...

say:52:1064004031:0.text: I... I can't take it anymore...

say:54:1064004032:1.text: I'm about to throw up, but not because I'm seasick...
say:54:1064004032:1.source_cn: 我要吐了，但不是因为晕船……

say:61:1064004035:1.text: I saw it! It moved! The fish bit the bait!

say:64:1064004036:0.text: Despite the damedangler's fierce resistance, you manage to tame it and reel it in.
say:64:1064004036:0.source_cn: 虽然冥湾美人在剧烈挣扎，但你们仍然成功钓到了它。

say:67:1064004038:1.text: ...It doesn't deserve such a nice name at all.

say:69:1064004039:0.text: Maybe it's beautiful in the eyes of other fish! Look at its sharp teeth, elegant light, and rough scales...
say:69:1064004039:0.source_cn: 说不定在深海里，这确实是美人。看看这锋利的尖牙，这优雅...

say:72:1064004041:1.text: Um, does its tail fin always carry a giant clam?
say:72:1064004041:1.source_cn: 呃，夹着巨蚌的尾鳍也是特征之一吗？

choice:28:0:1.text: It's a deep-sea fish, we'll have to overlook its appearance.
choice:28:0:1.source_cn: 毕竟是深海鱼，长成这样也没办法
choice:28:0:1.male: It's a deep-sea fish, we'll have to overlook its appearance.
choice:28:0:1.female: It's a deep-sea fish, we'll have to overlook its appearance.

choice:21:0:1.source_cn: 或许还有一种选择——冥湾美人

narration:0:1064005001:0.text: As Chilchuck speaks, the giant clam starts thrashing wildly. You struggle to maintain your grip on the fishing rod, trying not to be dragged into the sea.
narration:0:1064005001:0.source_cn: 齐尔查克的话音还没有落下，巨蚌就已经在疯狂摇动。你拿着...

narration:1:1064005002:0.text: Seeing this, the others rush over to help, engaging in a fierce tug of war against the damedangler and the giant clam.
narration:1:1064005002:0.source_cn: 其他人见状也涌上前来帮忙，与冥湾美人和尾后的巨蚌展开了...

narration:2:1064005003:1.text: However, because both sides are pulling against each other, the ship loses control and starts drifting off aimlessly...

narration:3:1064005004:1.text: The ship drifts along the surging waves for a long time before finally running aground on an island.

narration:4:1064005005:1.text: You get off the ship and settle down to rest on the island.

say:7:1064005006:0.text: Hmm, the ship seems fine. We can head out once the tide comes in.
say:7:1064005006:0.source_cn: 唔，船身好像没有太大损伤，等涨潮了应该就能离开。

say:9:1064005007:1.text: Fortunately, we managed to catch the damedangler. We almost let all our previous efforts go to waste.
say:9:1064005007:1.source_cn: 幸好冥湾美人被控制住了，不然之前的努力就白费了。

say:11:1064005008:1.text: Though it came with a giant clam attached.

say:13:1064005009:1.text: The damedangler's liver is okay, right?
say:13:1064005009:1.source_cn: 应该不会影响到冥湾美人的肝脏吧？

say:14:1064005010:1.text: The organs should be fine. I'll have to handle the fish with caution.
say:14:1064005010:1.source_cn: 对内脏不会有损伤，只是处理的时候要小心。

say:15:1064005011:1.text: ...Wait, why do I feel like something's missing?
say:15:1064005011:1.source_cn: ……等等，总觉得以上对话中好像少了些什么。

say:17:1064005013:1.text: Ah, where's Laios? He isn't here!
say:17:1064005013:1.source_cn: 啊！是莱欧斯！莱欧斯不见了！

choice_prompt:18:1064005013.text: Ah, where's Laios? He isn't here!
choice_prompt:18:1064005013.source_cn: 啊！是莱欧斯！莱欧斯不见了！

say:19:1064005014:1.text: Oh boy, don't tell me he's fallen into the sea!
say:19:1064005014:1.source_cn: 糟糕，莱欧斯不会掉海里了吧？

say:21:1064005016:1.text: …We're at sea, so just being able to swim isn't enough!
say:21:1064005016:1.source_cn: ……掉海里也不是会游泳能解决的吧？！

say:22:1064005017:1.text: We have to go help Laios quickly!

choice_prompt:23:1064005017.text: We have to go help Laios quickly!

say:26:1064005018:0.text: You all spread out to search the ship and the shore for Laios.
say:26:1064005018:0.source_cn: 你们分散开来，在船上和附近的浅滩上寻找莱欧斯的踪迹。

say:32:1064005021:1.text: There's no sign of him on the shore.
say:32:1064005021:1.source_cn: 浅滩这里没有他的踪迹。

say:33:1064005022:1.text: He isn't on the ship either.

say:36:1064005023:0.text: Suddenly, a barking dog in the distance interrupts your discussion.
say:36:1064005023:0.source_cn: 突然，远处传来一阵狗叫声，打断了你们的讨论。

say:40:1064005025:0.text: A dog? On this deserted island?

choice_prompt:41:1064005025.text: A dog? On this deserted island?

say:43:1064005026:0.text: You follow the barking and find yourselves standing beneath a large tree.
say:43:1064005026:0.source_cn: 你们循着狗叫声，来到了一棵大树下。

say:44:1064005027:1.text: *Woof*! A huge white bloodhound barks fiercely at you.
say:44:1064005027:1.source_cn: 而一只庞大的白毛猎犬，正在“汪汪汪汪汪”地朝你们狂吠着。

say:45:1064005028:1.text: It frantically wags its tail before charging toward you, teeth bared.
say:45:1064005028:1.source_cn: 随后，白毛猎犬疯狂地摇动着尾巴，呲着牙向你们狂奔而来。

say:47:1064005029:1.text: A hunting dog?! And it's aggressive?!
say:47:1064005029:1.source_cn: 猎犬？！还有，也太凶暴了吧？！

say:51:1064005031:1.text: Watch out! It's going to catch up to us!

say:55:1064005033:1.text: Panic-stricken, Marcille hurls her magic tome toward the bloodhound, striking it squarely on the head.
say:55:1064005033:1.source_cn: 玛露西尔情急之下，将手中的魔法书扔了过去，正中猎犬的头部——

say:57:1064005034:1.text: The bloodhound collapses with a thud. A bright, melodic laughter ripples through the air before Tasi appears, her enormous butterfly wings fluttering gracefully.
say:57:1064005034:1.source_cn: 猎犬应声倒地。同时，一阵银铃般的笑声响起，扇着巨大蝴蝶...

say:60:1064005035:0.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈！太有趣了！好精彩的场面！

choice_prompt:61:1064005035.source_cn: 哈哈哈哈哈！太有趣了！好精彩的场面！

say:63:1064005036:1.text: Could it be that this was the work of this thing?
say:63:1064005036:1.source_cn: 所以，这一切都是这位……搞的鬼？

say:64:1064005037:0.text: I guess so... Everyone, this is Tasi, the fairy of dreams who loves playing pranks.
say:64:1064005037:0.source_cn: 应该是……各位，这是塔西，一个喜欢恶作剧的梦守妖精。

say:66:1064005038:1.text: I was sure that Laios was here...
say:66:1064005038:1.source_cn: 我还以为莱欧斯也在呢……

say:69:1064005039:0.text: Come on, take a closer look at the hound!
say:69:1064005039:0.source_cn: 哎呀，你们再仔细看看那个猎犬嘛！

say:70:1064005040:0.text: Huh? The dog isn't... Laios is lying on the ground!
say:70:1064005040:0.source_cn: 咦？狗不见了……等等，莱欧斯倒下了！

say:73:1064005042:0.text: Sorry, Laios! I didn't know it was you!
say:73:1064005042:0.source_cn: 啊，对不起，莱欧斯！我不知道那是你！

choice_prompt:74:1064005042.text: Sorry, Laios! I didn't know it was you!
choice_prompt:74:1064005042.source_cn: 啊，对不起，莱欧斯！我不知道那是你！

say:76:1064005043:0.text: Why should I apologize? I merely projected a dream one of you had.
say:76:1064005043:0.source_cn: 我才不要道歉呢，我只是投射了某个人梦境中的形象而已。

say:77:1064005044:0.text: I didn't lay a finger on him!

say:79:1064005045:0.text: ...What happened? Wasn't I chasing a Mermaid on a damedangler?
say:79:1064005045:0.source_cn: ……发生了什么？我不是骑在了冥湾美人身上追人鱼吗？

say:81:1064005047:0.text: Why does my head hurt so much? Like I just got smacked by something heavy.
say:81:1064005047:0.source_cn: 但我的头有点痛，感觉是被什么重物砸中了。

choice_prompt:82:1064005047.text: Why does my head hurt so much? Like I just got smacked by something heavy.
choice_prompt:82:1064005047.source_cn: 但我的头有点痛，感觉是被什么重物砸中了。

say:85:1064005049:1.text: Since you're fine, could you let it slide so we can all move on?
say:85:1064005049:1.source_cn: 人看起来没事，就让这件事这么过去吧……

say:86:1064005050:1.text: Ugh... I still don't feel quite myself...
say:86:1064005050:1.source_cn: 唔……好像哪里还是不太对劲……

say:87:1064005051:1.text: Oh, your head still hurts? Want me to heal you with magic? I'm confident in my speed!
say:87:1064005051:1.source_cn: 头还在痛吗？要不要我用魔法帮你回复下？回复的速度我可是...

say:89:1064005053:1.text: Ah! I think I'm just... starving! Maybe all that chasing my dream has drained my energy...
say:89:1064005053:1.source_cn: 啊！这种感觉是——饿了！梦里的追逐战也会消耗体力吗？

choice_prompt:90:1064005053.text: Ah! I think I'm just... starving! Maybe all that chasing my dream has drained my energy...
choice_prompt:90:1064005053.source_cn: 啊！这种感觉是——饿了！梦里的追逐战也会消耗体力吗？

say:91:1064005054:1.text: Let's forget about the dream! If you're hungry, let's cook some food here! We even have the ingredients, so come on!
say:91:1064005054:1.source_cn: 别管做梦了！莱欧斯已经饿了，总之我们现在开始做饭吧？手...

say:92:1064005055:1.text: ...This shift in topic is way too forced.

say:93:1064005056:0.text: Speaking of food, I'm feeling a bit hungry too.

say:95:1064005057:0.text: What are you guys planning to cook?
say:95:1064005057:0.source_cn: 所以你们要做什么吃呢？

say:96:1064005058:0.text: I saw all kinds of monster dishes in your dreams!
say:96:1064005058:0.source_cn: 我在你们的梦境里看到了各种各样的魔物料理！

say:97:1064005059:0.text: It looked really tasty. I want to eat it too!
say:97:1064005059:0.source_cn: 我好馋，我想吃，我要吃到！

say:99:1064005060:1.text: I don't mind preparing an extra set of cutlery.
say:99:1064005060:1.source_cn: 老夫倒是不介意多准备一副碗筷。

say:100:1064005061:0.text: But I need to make sure the ingredients are safe to eat, before anything else.
say:100:1064005061:0.source_cn: 不过首先要确保食材的安全程度。

say:101:1064005062:1.text: Don't worry, these can all be eaten raw!
say:101:1064005062:1.source_cn: 放心吧，这些都可以直接生吃！

say:103:1064005063:1.text: Raw? I'll pass. Getting food poisoning is the worst.
say:103:1064005063:1.source_cn: ……还是不要生吃了吧，食物中毒的感觉太差了。

say:105:1064005064:1.text: Nobody told you it was okay to eat raw parasites, alright? We're having seafood this time.
say:105:1064005064:1.source_cn: 你那是生吃寄生虫，和生吃海鲜完全不一样吧！

say:107:1064005065:0.text: Let's go with seafood congee then.
say:107:1064005065:0.source_cn: 那么，这次就做海鲜粥吧。

say:108:1064005066:0.text: I'll take out the damedangler's liver first, then cook the rest.
say:108:1064005066:0.source_cn: 老夫先把冥湾美人的肝脏取出保存，其余的部分就用在锅里吧。

say:110:1064005067:0.text: Let me throw some rice into the pot, add water, and bring it to a boil.
say:110:1064005067:0.source_cn: 先将生米放在锅中加水煮沸。

say:112:1064005068:0.text: In the meantime, I can open the clam's shell, cut the flesh into pieces, and put them into the pot.
say:112:1064005068:0.source_cn: 同时撬开蚌壳，将蚌肉和顶上的肉芽切块，下入锅中。

say:114:1064005069:0.text: Now, peel off the damedangler's skin and cut its flesh into slices. After adding the fish slices to the congee, sprinkle some white pepper and fish sauce to season.
say:114:1064005069:0.source_cn: 冥湾美人去皮切片后放入，最后撒上白胡椒和鱼露调味。

say:119:1064005072:0.text: How about you guys stay a couple more days on Dream Isle?
say:119:1064005072:0.source_cn: 你们要不要在藏梦岛多待几天呢？

say:121:1064005073:0.text: I can show you more exotic foods we have here!
say:121:1064005073:0.source_cn: 我可以带你们去找更多奇特食材！

choice_prompt:122:1064005073.text: I can show you more exotic foods we have here!
choice_prompt:122:1064005073.source_cn: 我可以带你们去找更多奇特食材！

say:123:1064005074:0.text: Well, I guess I have no reason to keep you here any longer...
say:123:1064005074:0.source_cn: 唉……你果然还是一如既往地忙啊。

say:124:1064005075:0.text: If that's the case, I won't insist. But at least let me thank you for the meal.
say:124:1064005075:0.source_cn: 既然不能多留你们，至少让我做出感谢！

say:125:1064005076:0.text: May you have a special dream tonight and even gain some insights for your journey!
say:125:1064005076:0.source_cn: 我会祝福你们今晚都做个特别的梦，说不定还有一些旅途的启示哦！

choice:122:0:1.text: They're looking for a party member.
choice:122:0:1.male: They're looking for a party member.
choice:122:0:1.female: They're looking for a party member.

choice:122:1:2.text: We need to hurry to Cedartown.
choice:122:1:2.male: We need to hurry to Cedartown.
choice:122:1:2.female: We need to hurry to Cedartown.

choice:74:0:1.source_cn: 你是不是也要说点什么，塔西

choice:41:0:1.text: I bet Laios can hear it too.
choice:41:0:1.source_cn: 莱欧斯应该也能听到狗叫
choice:41:0:1.male: I bet Laios can hear it too.
choice:41:0:1.female: I bet Laios can hear it too.

narration:0:1064006001:0.text: Although you all enjoy beautiful dreams, none of you remember anything from them, let alone gain any insights.
narration:0:1064006001:0.source_cn: 虽然你们做了美梦，但似乎都没有保留梦中的记忆，更别谈获...

narration:1:1064006002:0.text: Could this be yet another prank from Tasi? With that doubt in your mind, you set off for Cedartown.
narration:1:1064006002:0.source_cn: 该不会这也是塔西的恶作剧吧？你们抱着这样的猜测，去往了...

say:3:1064006003:1.text: The third ingredient is... a monster with psychic power? What's that?
say:3:1064006003:1.source_cn: 第三个食材——拥有精神属性的怪物……究竟是什么呢？

document:3:419:2.text:
<style="highlight">Ingredient 3: Psychic Monster Meat</style>
The psychic monster meat is both the trickiest yet the most essential ingredient, as these creatures can manipulate minds or create illusions.
It is recommended to wear a tinfoil hat during this step.
 
<style="highlight">Ingredient 4: Rich Element Essence</style>
Element essence serves as a medium to combine other ingredients. Any essence will do, as long as it is pure.
document:3:419:2.source_cn:
<style="highlight">【材料三·拥有精神属性的怪物肉】</style>
拥有精神属性的怪物肉最为危险，也最为关键。此类生物往往具有操控心智或制造幻象的能力。
处理肉块时需要格外小心精神污染。
 
<style="highlight">【材料四·浓郁的元素精华】</style>
浓郁的元素精华是联结其他材料的媒介，使用何种元素皆可，但必须为纯净元素。

choice_prompt:4:1064006003.text: The third ingredient is... a monster with psychic power? What's that?
choice_prompt:4:1064006003.source_cn: 第三个食材——拥有精神属性的怪物……究竟是什么呢？

say:6:1064006004:1.text: This Hypofiend can inflict mental trauma, so we mustn't let our guard down.
say:6:1064006004:1.source_cn: 这种魔物会造成精神创伤，不能掉以轻心。

say:10:1064006006:1.text: We have no other choice. Let's toughen up and finish it off quickly!
say:10:1064006006:1.source_cn: 没办法，只能大家打起精神，速战速决了！

narration:0:1064006501:0.text: After an intense battle, you overcome the Spectral Hawk Moth.
narration:0:1064006501:0.source_cn: 经过一场艰苦的战斗，你们击败了幻瞳鹰蛾。

narration:1:1064006502:0.text: Despite the victory, everyone is left exhausted from the psychological impact.
narration:1:1064006502:0.source_cn: 尽管取得了胜利，但每个人都或多或少地受到了精神冲击，陷...

say:3:1064006503:1.text: My head's throbbing... It's like someone's drumming inside my skull...
say:3:1064006503:1.source_cn: 头好痛……感觉有人在脑子里打鼓……

say:4:1064006504:0.text: I can barely move my limbs... Is this the result of the mental trauma?
say:4:1064006504:0.source_cn: 四肢都使不上力气……这就是精神创伤吗？

choice_prompt:5:1064006504.text: I can barely move my limbs... Is this the result of the mental trauma?
choice_prompt:5:1064006504.source_cn: 四肢都使不上力气……这就是精神创伤吗？

say:8:1064006506:0.text: I could really use a good soak in the hot spring!

narration:10:1064006507:1.text: You bring Laios and the rest to the Frozen Paw, where you receive a warm reception and hospitable service from the owner, Gerda.

narration:11:1064006508:1.text: Having resolved the crisis that once plagued Cedartown, you are now a lifetime VIP of the Frozen Paw.

say:13:1064006509:1.source_cn: 欢迎各位来到白熊温泉旅店！

say:14:1064006510:1.text: I've prepared everything you'll need for the bath. Feel free to help yourself!
say:14:1064006510:1.source_cn: 相关用品我已经准备好了，请随意使用！

say:15:1064006511:1.text: If you need anything, just give me a shout! These ears of mine won't miss a single thing!
say:15:1064006511:1.source_cn: 有什么需要随时叫我，我都能听到！

say:16:1064006512:0.text: Your butler, Lorsan, will take his leave now!
say:16:1064006512:0.source_cn: 你们的管家洛桑先告退了！

say:18:1064006513:0.text: ...Look at you, Lorsan! You're acting like a pro now!

say:19:1064006514:0.text: I went through some training at another hot spring inn. Now I know all the best ways to treat our guests!
say:19:1064006514:0.source_cn: 我被送去了另一家豪华温泉旅馆进修！学习了最新的服务技巧！

say:21:1064006515:1.text: Wow, his hearing is amazing! He can hear us even from such a distance.
say:21:1064006515:1.source_cn: 他的兔耳朵也太灵敏了，离这么远还能听到我们说话。

choice_prompt:22:1064006515.text: Wow, his hearing is amazing! He can hear us even from such a distance.
choice_prompt:22:1064006515.source_cn: 他的兔耳朵也太灵敏了，离这么远还能听到我们说话。

say:24:1064006516:1.text: A Windwhisperer can pick up distant voices through the wind.
say:24:1064006516:1.source_cn: 风语者能从风中倾听到远方的声音。

say:26:1064006517:1.text: Chilchuck, your ears are pretty sharp too, right? I wonder who can hear better?
say:26:1064006517:1.source_cn: 齐尔查克的听觉也很好呢，不知道跟风语者比如何？

say:28:1064006518:1.text: ...My race just has better hearing in general, but it isn't a special power like the Windwhisperers have.
say:28:1064006518:1.source_cn: ……我这是种族特性，不是这种特殊能力啦。

say:29:1064006519:1.text: But right now, let's hurry and get into the hot springs.
say:29:1064006519:1.source_cn: 别想这些了，快去泡温泉吧。

say:30:1064006520:1.text: I just want to soak in the water without thinking about anything, and wash away all the terrifying illusions I saw during the battle...
say:30:1064006520:1.source_cn: 我只想泡进温泉里什么都不想，把刚刚战斗时看到的恐怖幻影...

narration:32:1064006521:0.text: After preparing, everyone leisurely enjoyed the hot spring. Enveloped in the warm water, fatigue melted away in an instant.
narration:32:1064006521:0.source_cn: 你们各自做好了准备进入了温泉池，温热的泉水立刻缓解了大...

narration:33:1064006522:0.text: After a long, relaxing soak, you gather in the lounge to chat.
narration:33:1064006522:0.source_cn: 过了许久，你们泡完了温泉，聚在一旁的休息区聊天。

say:36:1064006523:0.text: I wish there were hot springs in the dungeon...
say:36:1064006523:0.source_cn: 迷宫里要是也有温泉就好了……

say:38:1064006524:0.text: There's no way one could be made that easily, given the intricate layout of the dungeon.
say:38:1064006524:0.source_cn: 哪有那么容易，迷宫的空间构造可是很复杂的。

say:39:1064006525:1.text: You'd understand it if you brush up on your magic basics, Chilchuck.
say:39:1064006525:1.source_cn: 齐尔查克，你真应该补点魔法常识了。

say:40:1064006526:1.text: Senshi, remember to wash your beard afterwards.

say:44:1064006528:1.text: I'll have to take care of my hair later too.
say:44:1064006528:1.source_cn: 我待会也要好好护理头发呢。

say:45:1064006529:1.text: Speaking of hair... your hair is extremely shiny, Merlin. How do you usually take care of it?
say:45:1064006529:1.source_cn: 说到这个……梅林，你的头发好有光泽，平时都是怎么保养的啊？

choice_prompt:46:1064006529.text: Speaking of hair... your hair is extremely shiny, Merlin. How do you usually take care of it?
choice_prompt:46:1064006529.source_cn: 说到这个……梅林，你的头发好有光泽，平时都是怎么保养的啊？

say:47:1064006530:1.text: What?! I can't believe there's such a convenient ability...
say:47:1064006530:1.source_cn: 什么？！这能力也太作弊了吧。

say:49:1064006531:1.text: Mages can freely change their appearance.
say:49:1064006531:1.source_cn: 主人还能随意改变长相。

say:52:1064006533:1.text: I want to learn high-level magic like that!
say:52:1064006533:1.source_cn: 我也想学这种高级魔法！

say:53:1064006534:1.text: Keeping up my appearance in the dungeon is quite a challenge...
say:53:1064006534:1.source_cn: 在迷宫里，外表总是很难打理……

say:55:1064006535:1.text: And we never get proper rest.
say:55:1064006535:1.source_cn: 还总是没时间好好休息。

say:57:1064006536:1.text: I never thought we'd get the chance to unwind like this.
say:57:1064006536:1.source_cn: 现在能享受温泉，也算是难得的惊喜了。

say:59:1064006537:0.text: True. We should savor this moment...
say:59:1064006537:0.source_cn: 说得也是，这种时刻真该好好珍惜啊……

narration:62:1064006538:0.text: The fatigue from the mental trauma gradually fades away.
narration:62:1064006538:0.source_cn: 随着时间推移，精神创伤带来的疲惫渐渐消退。

narration:63:1064006539:0.text: Meanwhile, Lorsan has got dinner ready for you all.
narration:63:1064006539:0.source_cn: 与此同时，“管家”洛桑，也为你们准备好了晚餐——

say:65:1064006540:1.text: This is our local specialty—venison dumplings with sour cream. Please give it a try!
say:65:1064006540:1.source_cn: 各位超级贵宾，请尝尝我们雪松镇的特色——鹿肉饺蘸酸奶油。

picture:65::2.source_cn: 麋鹿饺蘸酸奶油与冰晶莓奶冻

say:69:1064006542:1.text: The flavor of the venison and the sour cream make a perfect match.
say:69:1064006542:1.source_cn: 嗯，鹿肉的野味与酸奶油完美融合。

say:70:1064006543:0.text: And this is crystalberry panna cotta, a personal treat from me!
say:70:1064006543:0.source_cn: 还有这个！冰晶莓奶冻，这是我自掏腰包赠送给各位贵宾的！

say:73:1064006544:0.text: Yum yum! It's velvety smooth with just the right touch of sweetness!

say:74:1064006545:0.text: If you can't finish the food, I'd be happy to pack up the rest for you!

say:76:1064006546:0.text: Really? That's so thoughtful of you!
say:76:1064006546:0.source_cn: 真的吗？服务也太周到了！

say:77:1064006547:1.text: Hee-hee, if you enjoy my service, please leave a 10,000-word review for me on the feedback form. I'd be forever grateful!
say:77:1064006547:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，只需在服务反馈表上帮管家洛桑撰写10000字评价即可！

choice_prompt:78:1064006547.text: Hee-hee, if you enjoy my service, please leave a 10,000-word review for me on the feedback form. I'd be forever grateful!
choice_prompt:78:1064006547.source_cn: 嘿嘿，只需在服务反馈表上帮管家洛桑撰写10000字评价即可！

say:80:1064006548:1.text: Here's a pen, Magister Merlin. You can start writing now!
say:80:1064006548:1.source_cn: 梅林大人，笔给你，现在就可以开始写了！

narration:81:1064006549:1.text: There's no such thing as a free lunch in this world...

choice:78:0:1.text: How many words did you say...?
choice:78:0:1.male: How many words did you say...?
choice:78:0:1.female: How many words did you say...?

choice:46:0:1.source_cn: 我的头发是魔法幻化的，所以不需要保养

choice:5:0:1.text: Fancy having a hot spring bath?
choice:5:0:1.male: Fancy having a hot spring bath?
choice:5:0:1.female: Fancy having a hot spring bath?

say:1:1064007001:0.text: Now, we just need one final ingredient—concentrated elemental essence—and we'll be ready to prepare the Summoner's Stew!
say:1:1064007001:0.source_cn: 只差最后一种食材——浓郁的元素精华，我们就能制作混沌虚...

say:3:1064007002:1.text: I hope everything goes well this time...

choice_prompt:4:1064007002.text: I hope everything goes well this time...

say:8:1064007004:0.text: So, about our next stop... Can you guys tell me more about it?
say:8:1064007004:0.source_cn: 那这次，我们要去的地方是什么样的呢？

choice_prompt:9:1064007004.text: So, about our next stop... Can you guys tell me more about it?
choice_prompt:9:1064007004.source_cn: 那这次，我们要去的地方是什么样的呢？

say:11:1064007005:1.text: This place is split into two areas—the surface, where Brimstone Village bustles with talented dwarf craftsmen.
say:11:1064007005:1.source_cn: 这里有两个区域，一个是地面之上，那里有一个矮人工匠村—...

say:14:1064007007:1.text: And the underground, and we're now heading to its lava area.
say:14:1064007007:1.source_cn: 另一个就是地底，我们这次去的就是位于那里的熔岩区。

say:15:1064007008:1.text: A dragon once lived there, which makes the place special.
say:15:1064007008:1.source_cn: 那里很特别，还曾经生活着龙呢。

say:19:1064007010:1.text: Calm down, Laios. The dragon has flown away.
say:19:1064007010:1.source_cn: 莱欧斯，你不要太激动，龙已经飞走了。

say:23:1064007013:0.text: May I ask some questions about the dragon?
say:23:1064007013:0.source_cn: 既然已经这样了……那我可以问几个问题吗？

choice_prompt:24:1064007013.text: May I ask some questions about the dragon?
choice_prompt:24:1064007013.source_cn: 既然已经这样了……那我可以问几个问题吗？

say:26:1064007014:1.text: Are there any differences between the Primordial Dragon and the Red Dragon?
say:26:1064007014:1.source_cn: 好，请问初始之龙跟炎龙有什么区别？

say:27:1064007015:1.text: How big is the Primordial Dragon? Can it breathe fire?
say:27:1064007015:1.source_cn: 体型大小如何？会喷火吗？

say:28:1064007016:1.text: What kind of habitat does it live in? And what does its meat taste like?
say:28:1064007016:1.source_cn: 生活的环境怎么样呢？肉又是什么味道的呢？

choice_prompt:29:1064007016.text: What kind of habitat does it live in? And what does its meat taste like?
choice_prompt:29:1064007016.source_cn: 生活的环境怎么样呢？肉又是什么味道的呢？

say:35:1064007019:1.text: Is that true?! I've never seen a dragon egg!
say:35:1064007019:1.source_cn: 真的吗！？我还没有见过龙蛋！

say:36:1064007020:1.text: When I think of a dragon-like creature hatching from an egg, I get goosebumps...
say:36:1064007020:1.source_cn: 一想到龙这种生物是从龙蛋里孵化出来，我就忍不住战栗了起来。

say:37:1064007021:1.text: Life is amazing, isn't it? A tiny hatchling can eventually grow into such a mighty creature...
say:37:1064007021:1.source_cn: 生物真的很不可思议呢……竟然能从那样的蛋成长为如此强大...

narration:42:1064007024:1.text: At Laios' urging, you make it to Ironhold Bay without a hitch.

narration:43:1064007025:1.text: You weave your way through the bustling streets of Brimstone Village and step into the mine, where you run into your old dwarven friend, Zanie.

say:46:1064007027:1.text: Hey there! I see you have four new companions...
say:46:1064007027:1.source_cn: 嗨，是你们啊！后面这四个……

say:47:1064007028:1.text: Quite the unusual crew you've brought along today!
say:47:1064007028:1.source_cn: 真是一个少见的组合啊。

choice_prompt:48:1064007028.text: Quite the unusual crew you've brought along today!
choice_prompt:48:1064007028.source_cn: 真是一个少见的组合啊。

say:50:1064007029:1.text: I'm glad that everyone can get to know each other, but introducing everyone each time is quite exhausting...
say:50:1064007029:1.source_cn: 虽然能让大家认识很开心，但每次都要介绍也是挺累的呢……

say:51:1064007030:1.text: Don't complain, Hammie. I've been introducing myself so much lately.
say:51:1064007030:1.source_cn: 别抱怨了，我最近可是一直不停的自我介绍呢。

say:52:1064007031:1.text: Investment, transport, research—one thing after another keeps coming at me, and honestly, I'm sick of it.
say:52:1064007031:1.source_cn: 什么投资啊、运输啊、研究啊，接二连三地来，说实话我已经...

say:53:1064007032:1.text: For a moment, I thought you were bringing Senshi here to mine!
say:53:1064007032:1.source_cn: 我差点以为你们介绍森西过来采矿呢。

say:55:1064007033:1.text: ...Well, I'm more or less like a cook.
say:55:1064007033:1.source_cn: ……老夫，可以说是个厨师之类的人吧。

say:56:1064007034:1.text: Oh, r-really? I see. That's... quite a rare profession among dwarves.
say:56:1064007034:1.source_cn: 啊，这样啊。这在矮人中也是挺少见的哈。

say:59:1064007036:1.text: So, uh... let's go grab the elemental essence, shall we?
say:59:1064007036:1.source_cn: 那个，这个……总之我们现在去弄元素精华吧。

say:61:1064007037:1.text: Catch you later, Zanie! You're a lovely little girl!
say:61:1064007037:1.source_cn: 祖娅小妹妹，很高兴认识你，再见！

say:63:1064007039:1.text: No way I'm a little girl! I'm already several hundred years old!
say:63:1064007039:1.source_cn: 我可不是小妹妹！我几百岁了哦！

say:65:1064007040:1.text: It's so hard to tell a dwarf's age.
say:65:1064007040:1.source_cn: 矮人的年龄也太难分辨了吧。

choice_prompt:66:1064007040.text: It's so hard to tell a dwarf's age.
choice_prompt:66:1064007040.source_cn: 矮人的年龄也太难分辨了吧。

say:67:1064007041:1.text: Actually, I've stopped growing after accidentally drinking the dragon egg essence.
say:67:1064007041:1.source_cn: 我这是误服龙蛋液导致的停止生长。

say:69:1064007042:0.text: Dragon egg essence has that effect?! Wow...
say:69:1064007042:0.source_cn: 龙蛋液？！还有这种副作用……

say:70:1064007043:0.text: Ah, there goes another ingredient we can eat.
say:70:1064007043:0.source_cn: 唉，又少了一种能吃的食材。

say:72:1064007044:1.text: Were you actually thinking of eating it?!

say:74:1064007045:1.text: Sorry! I just assumed you were a young dwarf...
say:74:1064007045:1.source_cn: 啊啊，对不起，我完全没看出来！我以为您只是个年轻矮人！

say:75:1064007046:1.text: If I've offended you, I'll apologize.

say:76:1064007047:1.text: Heh, don't take it to heart! It's always fun to mess with new friends about my age. Haha!
say:76:1064007047:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，别放在心上。偶尔用这个吓新认识的人一跳，还是挺有...

say:77:1064007048:1.text: The looks on your faces really made my day!
say:77:1064007048:1.source_cn: 你们现在的表情也值回票价了。

choice_prompt:78:1064007048.text: The looks on your faces really made my day!
choice_prompt:78:1064007048.source_cn: 你们现在的表情也值回票价了。

say:79:1064007049:1.text: I blame that pink pointy-eared dude! I hope you don't have to deal with him this time.
say:79:1064007049:1.source_cn: 都怪那个粉毛尖耳朵。你们这次不会也要跟他打交道吧？

say:80:1064007050:1.text: Pointy ears? Are there elves in Esperia too?
say:80:1064007050:1.source_cn: 尖耳朵？伊索米亚这里也有精灵吗？

say:81:1064007051:1.text: Now that you mention it, their ears are quite similar to yours...
say:81:1064007051:1.source_cn: 这么说来，耳朵确实有一点像……

say:83:1064007052:0.text: Technically, they're not elves, but a unique race with a complicated history.
say:83:1064007052:0.source_cn: 但准确来说，他们不是精灵。是有着特殊复杂过去的族群……

say:84:1064007053:0.text: The story's quite dull, so I'll spare you from it.
say:84:1064007053:0.source_cn: 那可不是什么多有意思的事情。

say:86:1064007054:1.text: Let's talk as we go. I'm on my way to collect some nightshards.
say:86:1064007054:1.source_cn: 我们边走边聊吧，我准备去采集点暗烬晶体。

say:87:1064007055:1.text: There's this new dish I just learned from Finn—crystallized mushroom soup!
say:87:1064007055:1.source_cn: 芬恩教了我一个新食谱——晶化伞菇浓汤。

say:89:1064007056:1.source_cn: 这名字，听起来不是很好吃……

say:90:1064007057:1.text: Haha! Cooking is the same as research. Don't be bound by convention—if you don't take chances once in a while, you'll never make discoveries, right?
say:90:1064007057:1.source_cn: 嘿！做菜就像搞研究，不能故步自封。有时候冒险才有惊喜！

say:92:1064007058:1.text: I agree. I'm always testing out new recipes with different monsters in the dungeon myself...
say:92:1064007058:1.source_cn: 老夫很同意这个说法。在迷宫里，老夫也经常尝试各种魔物组合……

narration:93:1064007059:1.text: Zanie and Senshi, having found some common ground, dive into a conversation about the ways research and cooking overlap.

narration:94:1064007060:1.text: Later that day, you ride the arcane lift together to gather the ingredients you need.

choice:4:0:1.text: The essence is easy to collect.
choice:4:0:1.male: The essence is easy to collect.
choice:4:0:1.female: The essence is easy to collect.

narration:0:1064008001:0.text: After a painstaking search, you finally get your hands on some concentrated elemental essence.
narration:0:1064008001:0.source_cn: 经历了费时的寻找，你们成功收集到了浓郁的元素精华。

narration:1:1064008002:0.text: You head back to the mine and find Zanie waiting, a large pot of bubbling gray liquid in front of her.
narration:1:1064008002:0.source_cn: 随后，你们返回了矿洞里，祖娅已经在此等候。而她的面前正...

say:3:1064008003:1.text: You guys made it just in time!

say:4:1064008004:1.source_cn: 快来尝尝晶化伞菇浓汤！

choice_prompt:5:1064008004.source_cn: 快来尝尝晶化伞菇浓汤！

say:6:1064008005:1.text: Absolutely! I made the soup with nightshards, the fungus on the heads of hopping mushroom sprites, along with some flour and goat's milk.
say:6:1064008005:1.source_cn: 肯定能啊！原料是暗烬晶体、蹦蹦菇灵头上的小伞菌、面粉和羊奶。

say:8:1064008006:1.source_cn: 多正常啊！都是能吃的东西！

say:11:1064008007:1.text: Aside from flour and goat's milk, the other two are also "ordinary"...?
say:11:1064008007:1.source_cn: 面粉和羊奶以外的另两个也算普通吗……？

say:12:1064008008:1.text: Having "edible" as the only standard seems questionable...
say:12:1064008008:1.source_cn: 判断标准竟然是能不能吃吗……

say:13:1064008009:1.text: You're right. When it comes to mushrooms, we shouldn't throw caution to the wind.
say:13:1064008009:1.source_cn: 老夫也这么觉得，菌菇类食用起来需要格外小心。

say:14:1064008010:0.text: The color of this mushroom cap doesn't reassure me...
say:14:1064008010:0.source_cn: 这个菌伞的颜色看起来……不太妙啊。

say:16:1064008011:0.text: I'm surprised you caught that... The recipe mentioned fuzzy mushrooms, but I thought I'd add my own twist, so...
say:16:1064008011:0.source_cn: 竟然被发现了……食谱上写的是茸茸伞菇，但我灵机一动——

say:17:1064008012:0.text: I used the fungus from hopping mushroom sprites instead! S-Since they're both mushrooms, there shouldn't be any problems, right...
say:17:1064008012:0.source_cn: 换成了蹦蹦菇灵头上的小伞菌。反正、反正都是蘑菇，差不多...

choice_prompt:18:1064008012.text: I used the fungus from hopping mushroom sprites instead! S-Since they're both mushrooms, there shouldn't be any problems, right...
choice_prompt:18:1064008012.source_cn: 换成了蹦蹦菇灵头上的小伞菌。反正、反正都是蘑菇，差不多的吧……

say:19:1064008013:1.text: As I just said, the surprises are worth the risk!
say:19:1064008013:1.source_cn: 不不不，都说了冒险才有惊喜。

say:21:1064008014:0.text: Is the hopping mushroom sprite a type of monster?

say:22:1064008015:1.text: Is it like a Walking Mushroom?
say:22:1064008015:1.source_cn: 听起来有点像行走菇呢。

say:25:1064008017:1.text: Zanie, I'd like a bowl of the soup, please.

say:27:1064008018:1.text: I'm with you—people should always keep their spirit of curiosity alive!
say:27:1064008018:1.source_cn: 我非常认同你的观点，冒险精神是必不可少的东西！

say:28:1064008019:1.text: Y-You could think it over a little more, you know...

say:31:1064008021:1.text: Though everyone else is skeptical, Laios takes the bowl from Zanie and downs more than half the soup in one go.
say:31:1064008021:1.source_cn: 莱欧斯不顾你们的质疑，接过祖娅递来的碗，一口气喝下了大...

say:32:1064008022:1.text: All of you hold your breath, nervously watching his reaction.
say:32:1064008022:1.source_cn: 你们在一旁屏住呼吸，紧张地观察着他的反应。

say:34:1064008023:0.text: Mmm... There's a distinct mineral-like flavor, and the texture of the soup is incredibly smooth.
say:34:1064008023:0.source_cn: 唔……有种奇特的矿物质味道，质地很顺滑。

say:35:1064008024:0.text: And the smell of the mushroom... I can see a hopping mushroom sprite jumping right in front of me...
say:35:1064008024:0.source_cn: 又有菌菇的香气，好像能看到蹦蹦菇灵在我面前跳动……

say:37:1064008025:1.text: Hey! You're not hallucinating, are you?
say:37:1064008025:1.source_cn: 喂！你该不会产生幻觉了吧？

say:41:1064008027:1.text: Ah, the mushroom sprite is telling me to go that way—aghhh...
say:41:1064008027:1.source_cn: 啊，蹦蹦菇灵说要往那边去——呕呕呕呕呕……

say:44:1064008028:0.text: Laios stumbles over to a pillar and starts throwing up.
say:44:1064008028:0.source_cn: 莱欧斯跌跌撞撞地跑向了远处，扶着矿柱狂吐了起来。

say:46:1064008029:0.text: As the sound of him vomiting echoes through the mine, an air of awkwardness fills the space...
say:46:1064008029:0.source_cn: 回声在矿洞中反复回荡，场面更尴尬了……

say:48:1064008030:1.text: Um... I think my experiment has failed...

say:49:1064008031:1.text: I should have tried the soup myself first! So sorry!
say:49:1064008031:1.source_cn: 对不起！我太草率了！我应该先自己品尝的！

say:51:1064008032:1.text: Zanie, how could you not even try it yourself?!
say:51:1064008032:1.source_cn: 祖娅，你自己竟然都没尝过！

say:52:1064008033:1.text: I got carried away... Let me make it up to you with this turkey roll!
say:52:1064008033:1.source_cn: 我得意忘形了……作为赔罪，我请大家吃这个锻炉火鸡卷！

say:55:1064008035:0.text: Don't worry, I bought it from Gwenna in the village! It's 100% safe to eat!
say:55:1064008035:0.source_cn: 放心，这是村里葛文娜大娘做的，安全无毒！

say:61:1064008038:1.text: You share the turkey roll with complicated feelings.
say:61:1064008038:1.source_cn: 你们在莱欧斯的呕吐伴奏声中，面色复杂地分食了锻炉火鸡卷。

say:63:1064008039:0.text: The turkey roll is delicious, but Laios' retching in the background really kills your appetite.
say:63:1064008039:0.source_cn: 味道确实不错，只是背景音乐让人胃口大减。

say:64:1064008040:1.text: Surprisingly, Laios doesn't take long to rejoin the group...
say:64:1064008040:1.source_cn: 令人意外的是，莱欧斯很快回来了……

say:66:1064008041:1.text: I'm alright! I was unwell earlier, but now I feel better than ever!
say:66:1064008041:1.source_cn: 我没事了！虽然刚才有点不舒服，但现在感觉特别好！

say:67:1064008042:1.text: Let's prepare the Summoner's Stew right away! I can't wait any longer!
say:67:1064008042:1.source_cn: 我们快去做最后的黑暗召唤锅吧，我已经等不及了！

say:69:1064008043:1.text: Are you sure you've had enough rest?
say:69:1064008043:1.source_cn: 你确定吗？要不要再休息一下？

say:70:1064008044:1.text: Yes! Don't forget, Falin's still waiting for us. Let's move!
say:70:1064008044:1.source_cn: 不用不用，法琳还在等我们！快走吧！

choice_prompt:71:1064008044.text: Yes! Don't forget, Falin's still waiting for us. Let's move!
choice_prompt:71:1064008044.source_cn: 不用不用，法琳还在等我们！快走吧！

say:73:1064008045:1.text: ...This might be a side effect of the soup.

narration:75:1064008047:1.text: With Laios constantly pushing for an early departure, you say your goodbyes to Zanie, who still feels sorry for the mishap.

narration:76:1064008048:1.text: Now, all four ingredients are ready.

narration:77:1064008049:1.text: All that's left to do is prepare the dish according to the recipe.

choice:18:0:1.text: The worst thing in cooking is a novice's "inspiration".
choice:18:0:1.male: The worst thing in cooking is a novice's "inspiration".
choice:18:0:1.female: The worst thing in cooking is a novice's "inspiration".

say:3:1064009002:1.text: It's similar to what we have in the dungeon.
say:3:1064009002:1.source_cn: 和迷宫的感觉有些类似呢。

say:4:1064009003:1.text: Magister and Marcille have to work on the dimensional magic circle to determine your previous location accurately.

choice_prompt:5:1064009003.text: Magister and Marcille have to work on the dimensional magic circle to determine your previous location accurately.
choice_prompt:5:1064009003.source_cn: 为了精准地定位你们之前的位置，主人和玛露西尔得提前绘制空间魔法阵。

say:7:1064009004:1.text: How about the rest of you help me prepare our final dish?
say:7:1064009004:1.source_cn: 那其他人和老夫一起预处理食材，准备最终的料理吧。

say:9:1064009005:1.text: You divvy up the work and begin prepping the ingredients.
say:9:1064009005:1.source_cn: 你们根据各自的分工，开始准备起了最后的料理。

document:9:420:2.text:
<style="highlight">Cooking Steps</style>
Prepare a large cauldron. Add the ingredients in sequence while stirring continuously.
First stir three times clockwise, then twice counterclockwise. Repeat this process until the contents of the cauldron shimmer with a prismatic shade of black.
If it turns polka-dotted, you've stirred too vigorously.
document:9:420:2.source_cn:
<style="highlight">【烹制步骤】</style>
准备一个大坩埚，将材料依序放入后持续搅拌——
先顺时针三圈，再逆时针两圈，如此反复直至锅内呈现出五彩斑斓的黑色。

say:11:1064009006:1.text: Seriously, is the Summoner's Stew really not a potion?
say:11:1064009006:1.source_cn: 说真的……混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅真的不是魔药吗？

say:12:1064009007:1.text: Just think about what's inside—ancient bones, fish liver, monster meat, and elemental essence...
say:12:1064009007:1.source_cn: 远古生物骨骼、海底生物肝脏、精神系的怪物肉，还有元素精华……

say:13:1064009008:1.text: And then we're using this large cauldron.
say:13:1064009008:1.source_cn: 再加上这个熬煮的大坩埚。

say:14:1064009009:1.text: I feel like we'll end up with a dark, murky potion with a weird smell... It might even blow up in our faces!
say:14:1064009009:1.source_cn: 感觉最后会是黑乎乎的散发着奇怪气息的魔药……说不定还会爆炸！

say:16:1064009010:1.text: Well, regular food can have medicinal properties too. There's nothing wrong with a recipe looking like a prescription.
say:16:1064009010:1.source_cn: 很多食物也是药物，食谱像药方也没有问题。

say:19:1064009012:0.text: Marcille quiets down as she focuses on drawing the magic circle with you.
say:19:1064009012:0.source_cn: 玛露西尔安静了下来，和你一起专心地绘制魔法阵。

say:20:1064009013:1.text: Shortly after, the magic circle is complete, and all the ingredients are ready to be cooked.
say:20:1064009013:1.source_cn: 没过多久，魔法阵画好了。而所有的食材也处理完毕，只待下锅。

choice_prompt:21:1064009013.text: Shortly after, the magic circle is complete, and all the ingredients are ready to be cooked.
choice_prompt:21:1064009013.source_cn: 没过多久，魔法阵画好了。而所有的食材也处理完毕，只待下锅。

say:25:1064009015:1.text: Put the bones in first, then the fish liver and monster meat...
say:25:1064009015:1.source_cn: 先下远古生物骨骼，然后是海底生物肝脏和怪物肉——

say:26:1064009016:1.text: Last but not least, the elemental essence.

say:33:1064009020:0.text: Wait, that voice just now wasn't Laios?!
say:33:1064009020:0.source_cn: 不对，不是面前的莱欧斯在说话！

say:34:1064009021:0.text: Over there! Riding on an insect, flying this way... Laios?
say:34:1064009021:0.source_cn: 是那个……骑在虫上飞来的莱欧斯……

say:38:1064009023:0.text: All of you look up and see a massive Crystal Beetle flying toward the cauldron.
say:38:1064009023:0.source_cn: 你们放眼望去，一只巨大的幻晶犀甲虫正飞向坩埚。

say:39:1064009024:0.text: And on its back sits another Laios, who is frantically waving at you!
say:39:1064009024:0.source_cn: 而在它的背上，坐着另一个莱欧斯！他正在拼命地向你们挥手示意。

say:42:1064009025:1.text: Who are you? Why do you look exactly like me?
say:42:1064009025:1.source_cn: 你是谁？为什么你跟我一模一样？

say:43:1064009026:1.text: Drop the act! Did the Lunatic Magician send you here to stop us?
say:43:1064009026:1.source_cn: 别装了！你是狂乱魔法师派来阻止我们回去的吗？

say:44:1064009027:1.text: Kensuke is warning me. Monster! Show yourself!
say:44:1064009027:1.source_cn: 剑助已经在示警了，魔物！老实交代吧！

say:45:1064009028:1.text: Look who's talking! You're the one plotting something wicked with that Summoner's Stew!
say:45:1064009028:1.source_cn: 你才是想借着召唤锅做什么坏事吧！

say:48:1064009030:1.text: How come there are two Laioses?
say:48:1064009030:1.source_cn: 为什么会有两个莱欧斯？

say:49:1064009031:1.text: Ugh, to think it'd come to this at the very end...
say:49:1064009031:1.source_cn: 怎么事到临头反而出了大问题啊。

say:51:1064009032:1.text: Looks like we need to figure out who's the real deal.
say:51:1064009032:1.source_cn: 看来，我们得先弄清楚谁是真正的莱欧斯了。

choice_prompt:52:1064009032.text: Looks like we need to figure out who's the real deal.
choice_prompt:52:1064009032.source_cn: 看来，我们得先弄清楚谁是真正的莱欧斯了。

say:54:1064009033:0.text: Laios knows a lot about monsters. Let me give them a test.
say:54:1064009033:0.source_cn: 莱欧斯有着丰富的魔物知识，我先用这个考考他们。

say:55:1064009034:1.text: Hey, you two. What monsters are capable of conjuring doppelgangers?
say:55:1064009034:1.source_cn: 喂，两个莱欧斯。说说看造就两个莱欧斯的魔物。

say:57:1064009035:1.text: For starters, Shapeshifters can imitate their prey by reading their mind and memories.
say:57:1064009035:1.source_cn: 首先是变身怪，可以读取猎物的思维和记忆来伪装他人。

say:58:1064009036:1.text: Next, there are doppelgangers, which can take on the appearance of other creatures.
say:58:1064009036:1.source_cn: 其次是变形怪，这是可以拟态成其他生物的魔物。

say:59:1064009037:1.text: There might be other creatures that can do it too...
say:59:1064009037:1.source_cn: 别的魔法生物也有可能……

say:60:1064009038:1.text: Some other monsters can pull it off too...
say:60:1064009038:1.source_cn: 部分恶魔也具有这种能力……

say:62:1064009039:1.text: This doesn't work... Both of them know their stuff about monsters.
say:62:1064009039:1.source_cn: 行不通……两个人都对魔物了如指掌。

say:65:1064009041:1.text: Now, start barking. Whoever sounds most like a dog is the real Laios!
say:65:1064009041:1.source_cn: 你们两个，学狗叫。谁学的最像谁就是莱欧斯！

say:72:1064009044:1.text: They both do such a great job! What now?

say:76:1064009046:1.text: I'll know what to do later.

choice_prompt:77:1064009046.text: I'll know what to do later.

say:78:1064009047:1.text: Let me put in the elemental essence...
say:78:1064009047:1.source_cn: 来吧，让老夫下入最后的元素精华……

choice:52:0:1.text: Any ideas on how to do this?
choice:52:0:1.male: Any ideas on how to do this?
choice:52:0:1.female: Any ideas on how to do this?

choice:2:1:2.text: You can return safely from here.
choice:2:1:2.source_cn: 适合将你们安全送回去
choice:2:1:2.male: You can return safely from here.
choice:2:1:2.female: You can return safely from here.

narration:0:1064010001:1.text: The mixture in the cauldron churns violently, releasing a peculiar smell.

picture:2::1.source_cn: 混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅

say:2:1064010002:2.source_cn: 混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅，完成了。

say:6:1064010004:0.text: I can't see the chaotic monster anywhere.
say:6:1064010004:0.source_cn: 混沌类魔物好像并没有出现。

say:7:1064010005:1.text: Maybe... we really can't go home after all.

say:9:1064010006:1.text: Hey, don't forget there are two Laios with us.
say:9:1064010006:1.source_cn: 而且还是有两个莱欧斯啊。

say:10:1064010007:1.source_cn: 那我们就先解决莱欧斯的问题吧。

say:11:1064010008:1.text: Laios, would you like to try the stew?
say:11:1064010008:1.source_cn: 莱欧斯，要不要尝尝混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅？

picture:11::2.source_cn: 混沌虚空之黑暗召唤锅

say:14:1064010010:1.text: I wonder what it tastes like. Will it have any special effects?
say:14:1064010010:1.source_cn: 不知道尝起来是什么味道？会有什么特殊效果吗？

say:18:1064010012:1.text: The Laios who came later is the real one. I know he would never turn down my cooking.
say:18:1064010012:1.source_cn: 后面过来的莱欧斯是真的，真正的莱欧斯不会拒绝老夫烹饪的料理。

say:20:1064010013:0.text: The Laios who's been with us all along is fake!
say:20:1064010013:0.source_cn: 一直跟着我们的莱欧斯是假的！

say:23:1064010015:0.text: Who are you? Do you really work for the Lunatic Magician?
say:23:1064010015:0.source_cn: 你是谁？不会真的是狂乱魔法师派来的吧？

say:26:1064010017:0.text: Since no one can figure out who I am, I shall...
say:26:1064010017:0.source_cn: 既然没人能猜出我的身份，我——

choice_prompt:27:1064010017.text: Since no one can figure out who I am, I shall...
choice_prompt:27:1064010017.source_cn: 既然没人能猜出我的身份，我——

say:28:1064010018:1.text: The fake Laios' face breaks into a sinister grin.
say:28:1064010018:1.source_cn: 假莱欧斯的表情瞬间凝固，随后露出一个诡异的笑容。

say:30:1064010019:0.text: His body twists and shifts, eventually morphing into Berial's appearance.
say:30:1064010019:0.source_cn: 他的身形开始扭曲和变化，最终化为了贝利尔的模样。

say:32:1064010020:1.text: Too bad! Seems like I can't fool anyone with the same trick this time.
say:32:1064010020:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，看来玩过一次的把戏不能再玩第二次了。

say:33:1064010021:1.text: Merlin, it's annoying how sharp you are!
say:33:1064010021:1.source_cn: 梅林，真讨厌！你还是这么敏锐！

choice_prompt:34:1064010021.text: Merlin, it's annoying how sharp you are!
choice_prompt:34:1064010021.source_cn: 梅林，真讨厌！你还是这么敏锐！

say:35:1064010022:1.text: Just to be clear, I mean no harm.
say:35:1064010022:1.source_cn: 别误会，我可没带着什么邪恶目的前来。

say:36:1064010023:1.text: I heard someone was trying to summon a chaotic monster, so I came and joined the fun!
say:36:1064010023:1.source_cn: 只是听说有人要召唤混沌类魔物，特意来看看热闹罢了！

say:38:1064010024:1.text: ...But you pretended to be me and misled everyone.
say:38:1064010024:1.source_cn: ……但你假扮了我还试图混淆大家。

say:40:1064010025:1.text: How did you manage to catch up with us, Laios?
say:40:1064010025:1.source_cn: 不过莱欧斯，你怎么赶过来的？

say:41:1064010026:1.text: Oh, I ran into this weird pair of twins, and they helped me out!
say:41:1064010026:1.source_cn: 我遇到了一对奇怪的双胞胎，他们帮助了我。

say:42:1064010027:1.text: Ugh, Elijah & Lailah! It was fun pretending to be someone from another dimension!
say:42:1064010027:1.source_cn: 可恶的伊莱亚和莱拉！我只是想扮成异界来客找点乐子！

say:44:1064010028:1.text: How could you tell we're from another dimension?
say:44:1064010028:1.source_cn: 你怎么知道我们来自异界？

choice_prompt:45:1064010028.text: How could you tell we're from another dimension?
choice_prompt:45:1064010028.source_cn: 你怎么知道我们来自异界？

say:46:1064010029:1.text: Hey, do you really have to expose me so soon?
say:46:1064010029:1.source_cn: 什么嘛？这就揭穿了我的身份吗？

say:47:1064010030:1.source_cn: 你真是一点都不懂得保留悬念的乐趣——

say:48:1064010031:1.text: Before Berial finishes his sentence, a glaring light suddenly radiates from the cauldron.
say:48:1064010031:1.source_cn: 贝利尔的话还未说完，坩埚突然爆发出刺目的光芒。

say:49:1064010032:1.text: Following a violent distortion in the space, a massive, shadowy figure emerges.
say:49:1064010032:1.source_cn: 空间开始剧烈扭曲，一个巨大的模糊身影若隐若现。

say:51:1064010033:1.text: That's the monster that brought us to Esperia!
say:51:1064010033:1.source_cn: 是它！那个把我们带来伊索米亚的魔物——

say:52:1064010034:1.text: I can't believe it actually showed up...!

choice_prompt:1:1064011001.text: Marcille gently taps the magic circle on the ground with Ambrosia, lighting it up. The next instant, a path reveals.
choice_prompt:1:1064011001.source_cn: 玛露西尔用安布萝西亚轻点脚下的法阵，法阵瞬间亮起并浮现出一道通往异次元的道路。

say:2:1064011001:0.text: Marcille gently taps the magic circle on the ground with Ambrosia, lighting it up. The next instant, a path reveals.
say:2:1064011001:0.source_cn: 玛露西尔用安布萝西亚轻点脚下的法阵，法阵瞬间亮起并浮现...

choice_prompt:3:1064011001.text: Marcille gently taps the magic circle on the ground with Ambrosia, lighting it up. The next instant, a path reveals.
choice_prompt:3:1064011001.source_cn: 玛露西尔用安布萝西亚轻点脚下的法阵，法阵瞬间亮起并浮现出一道通往异次元的道路。

say:8:1064011003:0.text: Laios, put me down! I can run on my own!
say:8:1064011003:0.source_cn: ——莱欧斯！我自己可以跑！不要拎着我啊！

say:13:1064011006:0.text: Laios, Marcille, Chilchuck, and Senshi dash forward, completely ignoring Berial's furious stomping and protests.
say:13:1064011006:0.source_cn: 莱欧斯、玛露西尔、齐尔查克和森西完全忽略了原地跳脚抗议...

say:16:1064011008:1.text: I'm glad I got to eat so much delicious, normal food!
say:16:1064011008:1.source_cn: 我吃到了很多美味的正常食物！非常开心！

say:18:1064011009:1.text: Thanks for the meal! Esperia was pretty tasty too!
say:18:1064011009:1.source_cn: 多谢款待！伊索米亚也很好吃！

say:22:1064011011:1.text: If you ever come this way again, I'll cook for you once more.
say:22:1064011011:1.source_cn: 等有机会你们来我们这边，老夫再给你们做料理。

narration:26:1064011013:1.text: Following a resounding burp, the four are slowly drawn into the opening in the warped dimension.

narration:27:1064011014:1.text: In the end, you hear Laios' voice.

narration:28:1064011015:1.text: "Can't I just try a bite before we go?"
